hooks.text: 队员被神秘能量束缚，任何人拉开过远都会让整队回到起点
hooks.excerpt: The main thing is not to stray too far from each other, otherwise... ready, set, go — back to the beginning!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 向上攀爬时难度持续抬升，不同区域会更换建筑结构、节奏和陷阱逻辑
hooks.excerpt: The world is one, but the levels in it are completely different. Architecture, pace, traps — everything is constantly changing so that you don't relax and think, “Well, now it will definitely be easier.”
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 配乐会随安全与高压跳跃场景切换，从舒缓背景转为强化紧张感
hooks.excerpt: The soundtrack changes with you. Calm moments sound pleasant... and then the platform with millimeter jumps begins, and the sound abruptly ceases to be background noise.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
